votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 05 of 2024 Recognizing March as National Women's History Month in Salt Lake City
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing March as National Women's History Month in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Items B-1 through B-6 to a future Consent Agenda for action
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on six grant applications (Rudy Drainage, 1300 East reconstruction, RMHIDTA, Annual Formula Per Capita, UCORE, and Marathon First Responder) and refers them to a future consent agenda for action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 08 of 2024 Zoning Text Amendment for Daycare Facilities
votes.description: Adopts a zoning text amendment to Title 21A aligning city daycare regulations with Utah State Code and reducing zoning barriers to childcare facilities citywide.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Zoning Map and General Plan Amendments at approximately 2445 South 500 East (Woodland Commons) to a future Council meeting
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezone from R-1/7,000 to RMF-35 at 2445 South 500 East and defers action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 09 of 2024 Yalecrest – Laird Heights Local Historic District
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance amending the zoning map to apply the H-Historic Overlay District, establishing the Yalecrest-Laird Heights Local Historic District for 66 homes on Laird Avenue.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Rezone and Master Plan Amendment at 803, 805, 807, and 815 West Simondi Avenue and 802, 806, 810, and 814 West 300 North to a future Council meeting
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezone from R1/7000 to RMF-30 and master plan amendment for properties on Simondi Avenue and 300 North, deferring action to allow more resident engagement.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 10 of 2024 Zoning Terms and Definitions Amendment
votes.description: Adopts a zoning text amendment removing Chapter 21A.60 List of Terms and amending Chapter 21A.62 Definitions for clarity and consistency without changing zoning standards or land use regulations.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the item on the Resolution Authorizing the Salt Lake County Housing Authority to Operate within Salt Lake City for the 44 North Apartments to a future date for action
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a resolution to allow Housing Connect to develop 67 affordable apartments at 44 and 48 North 1000 West, deferring action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the Fiscal Year 2024-25 Funding Allocations for One-year Action Plan for Community Development Block Grant & Other Federal Grants item to a future date for action
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the FY2024-25 HUD grant funding allocations including CDBG, HOME, ESG, and HOPWA programs, deferring action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 06 of 2024 University of Utah Baseball Stadium Public Benefits Analysis, approving the conclusions of the public benefit analysis, finding the lease fee waiver appropriate, and authorizing the administration to enter into the ground lease with the University on the terms set forth in the Term Sheet
votes.description: Approves a 99-year below-market ground lease of 1.175 acres of City-owned property at Sunnyside Park to the University of Utah for baseball field expansion, with the University committing $4.2 million for park improvements.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 11 of 2024 amending Titles 18 and 21A and enacting Title 19 of the Salt Lake City Code, known as the Community Benefit and Tenant Displacement Amendments, with a modification changing 'Preserving historic structures' to 'Preserving historic structures not otherwise protected'
votes.description: Adopts ordinance amendments to prevent loss of affordable housing, counteract tenant displacement, and provide tenant relocation assistance when displaced by new development, implementing the Thriving in Place anti-displacement plan.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 12 of 2024 amending various sections of Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code pertaining to the Landscaping and Buffers chapter, with enforcement on artificial turf installed prior to the effective date delayed 18 months
votes.description: Adopts landscaping and buffers regulations aimed at reducing water consumption, enhancing the urban forest, and improving air quality, with a delayed enforcement period for pre-existing artificial turf installations.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 13 of 2024 amending the Fiscal Year 2024 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document and amend the Appointed Pay Plan only for items as shown on the motion sheet
votes.description: Adopts Budget Amendment No. 4 for FY2023-24, including over $1.8 million for police officer overtime, three new fleet mechanics, $230,000 for air quality incentives, and other items.

votes.motion: Approve the appointment of Jill Love as the Salt Lake City Chief Administrative Officer
votes.description: Confirms the Mayor's appointment of Jill Love as the Salt Lake City Chief Administrative Officer.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 07 of 2024 Public Comment Policy
votes.description: Adopts a resolution amending the City Council's public comment policy, including provisions for written comments when in-person comment is unavailable.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 14 of 2024 amending Chapter 2.08.130 of the Salt Lake City Code to add a new Planning & Design Division and update the functions listed for the Department of Public Lands
votes.description: Creates a Division of Planning and Design within the Public Lands Department and updates the department's listed functions, related to Budget Amendment No. 4.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 08 of 2024 authorizing the City to consent to the transfer of Foreign Trade Zone authority to World Trade Center Utah
votes.description: Approves the transfer of Salt Lake City's Foreign-Trade Zone grantee status to World Trade Center Utah to take advantage of WTC Utah's staff capacity and resources.
Approves all consent agenda items including setting public hearing dates, grant holding account items, and multiple board appointments and reappointments.
